name: Lucemon: Larva
main_effect:
[Security] You may play 1 [Lucemon] from your trash without paying the cost.
[Breeding] [All Turns] When any of your [Lucemon: Satan Mode] would leave the battle area, by moving this Digimon to battle area, it doesn't leave.
[All Turns] While you have a non-white Digimon with [Lucemon] in its name, all of your 0 DP Digimon can't be deleted.
